summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode to admit (ControlType, str). rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry ("\x1b]0;{title}\x07") and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item code. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (the renderer test is Windows-only). Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing committed.
